FULL TEXT:
DEPARTMENT OF ECONOMICS
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH
NOTICE
Walk- in – Interview for appointment 01 Guest Faculty in Economics to teach Under
Graduate/ Post Graduate Course as per allotment for the semester starting from January,
2025 will be held on 22.01.2025 at 10:00 a.m. onwards in the office of the department of
Economics, Panjab University, Chandigarh as per the following tentative schedule:
Days of teaching Classes to be taught Subject to be taught & Working
Hours
Monday to Friday U.G. & P.G. Economics with specialization
in Mathematical Economics
9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.
All the applicants are advised to bring their original certificates and other relevant
documents for verification along with the duly filled form giving the details at the time of
interview. The application form for the post of Assistant Professor is available at website
(https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429-
directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2018.pdf).
The above assignment will be on lecture basis with a token honorarium of Rs. 1500/-
per lecture with an upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month. The candidate shall have to give an
undertaking that he/she will not draw any fellowship/stipend or any financial assistant from
any agency till they are teaching in Department of Economics, Panjab University,
Chandigarh as a Guest Faculty.
Minimum qualification for the post is as per UGC norms (link given below):
https://www.ugc.gov.in/oldpdf/regulations/3rd%20ammendment.pdf
Essential Qualifications as per clause 4.4.1 of UGC Regulations-2010:
i. Good academic record as defined by the concerned University with at least
55% marks (50% for SC/ST/Physically and Visually Handicapped) or an
equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed at the
Master’s degree level in a relevant subject from an Indian University or an
equivalent degree from an accredited foreign University.
ii. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate should have either
cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC; CSIR or
should have obtained Ph.D. Degree in Statistics.
iii. Notwithstanding anything contained in sub-clauses (i) and (ii) to this Clause
4.4.1, candidates, who are, or have been awarded a Ph. D. Degree in
accordance with the University Grants Commission (Minimum Standards
and Procedure for Award of Ph.D. Degree) Regulations, 2009 or the
subsequent Regulations if notified by the UGC, shall be exempted from the
requirement of the minimum eligibility condition of NET/SLET/SET for
recruitment and appointment of Assistant Professor or equivalent positions
in Universities /Colleges / Institutions.
Further, the award of degrees to candidates registered for the
M.Phil/Ph.D programme prior to July 11, 2009, shall be governed by
the provisions of the then existing Ordinances/ By laws/ Regulations of
the Institution awarding the degrees and the Ph.D candidates shall be
exempted from the requirement of the minimum eligibility condition of
“NET/SLET/SET for recruitment and appointment of Assistant
Professor or equivalent positions in Universities / Colleges / Institutions
subject to the fulfillment of the following conditions: -
(a) Ph.D. degree of the candidate awarded in regular mode only;
(b) Evaluation of the Ph.D. thesis by at least two external examiners;
(c) Candidate had published two research papers out of which at least
one in a refereed journal from out of his/her Ph.D. work;
(d) The candidate had presented two papers in seminars/conferences
from out of his/her Ph.D. work;
(e) Open Ph.D. viva-voce of the candidate had been conducted.
(a) to (e) as above are to be certified by the Vice Chancellor / Pro-
Vice-Chancellor/ Dean (Academic Affairs)/Dean (University
Instructions)”
iv. NET/SLET/SET shall also not be required for such Masters Programmes
in disciplines for which NET/SLET/SET is not conducted
Desirable Qualification:
a. Graduation with Economics and Maths/Statistics as an elective subject or B.A.
(Hons) in Economics.
b. Knowledge of MS Office/STATA/SPSS/Eviews/R/Python.
c. Proficient to teach Mathematical, Economics, Statistical papers and computer
software based paper/s for economics students.
No TA/DA will be paid for the same.
Sd/-
Chairperson
Department of Economics
Panjab University, Chandigarh
